description:
Read .lattice/notes/design-decisions-2026-07-04.md first. It binds this task.

Build a small Python web app (fasthtml or fastapi with datastar or htmx) that Valerie hosts on her own server. Not a static site. It imports lofbench directly, which keeps one source of truth for rendering.

The site needs:
1. the sandbox as centrepiece: type or pick a form, see it rendered in every dialect at once, server-rendered on request
2. headline chart: per-model sensitivity score from the frozen suite, baked from DB-5 parquet artifacts at deploy
3. a model-by-dialect matrix and paired-delta charts as second-level detail
4. a short axioms explainer (calling, crossing) using the CMY colour-cue pedagogy from the reference image
5. transcript walkthroughs, correct and failed
6. links out to the external writeup per release

Audience is eval researchers; rigour and legibility before polish. State the DB-5 artifact fields this site needs as requirements in the plan; DB-5 owns the schema. Deployment target is Valerie's server; keep ops light (one service, systemd or a container).
title: Site: python htmx/datastar server with dialect sandbox
